name: Xinghuan
quote: What's that darting between the stars? It is a white comet, blazing with passion and radiance.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning! Look at that face of yours... having trouble getting up? Ahahaha, I've long since mastered the art of managing my work and rest; after all, there's no day-night cycle in space. How about letting me wake you up next time?

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Hngh... You want to know what I'm doing? This is strength training under simulated zero-G conditions, an essential part of a taikonaut's curriculum. Want to give it a try, Professor? Just take my hand... All you need to do is enjoy this drifting sensation.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: The sun's gone down... After spending so long in space, it's a little hard to get used to a day-night cycle again. Haha, I just thought of an old space joke: "An astronaut was worried about the sun being too hot to land on. What did he do? He went at night!" ...Huh? But I thought it was pretty funny, no?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: (Yawn) Isn't it time for bed, Professor? Why are you still working? Your work can wait till tomorrow if it isn't that important... zzz... zzz...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Travelling the stars, blazing a trail into the unknown... Being a taikonaut's the most romantic job in the cosmos, don't you think? Nothing's more exciting than the fact that there's an infinite universe out there, just waiting for us to explore it.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: You've never seen this before, have you? Go ahead, come closer and take a look. This module is used for shielding you from vacuum and cosmic radiation. There's also this trigger, want to pull it? It might make your desk disintegrate with a "frzzap"... Eh, do you really not want to give it a try?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: "There's no greater joy than having adequate sleep" — That much is true. Ah, looking at your sleeping face makes me so happy, I wonder what kind of dreams you're having...

voices.label: Home Screen 4
voices.text: Her outfit and helmet reminds me of a 20th century astronaut... I should try and get to know her.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: "Enterprise 1701" reporting, ready to set sail on a scouting mission! Need me to take any picture of the scenery in space?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: nuqneH!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Are you interested in the design of my mech? Hehehe, that's only to be expected.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: "Liuxing," come say hi— Ahaha, he seems to be a little shy.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Sure thing.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text:
Hello~
This is Xinghuan the taikonaut, freshly returned from the stars! Want to hear a story about my space travels, Professor?

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Functional enhancement complete. Looks like I can go even further now.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: The day will come when every star system will be explored and every riddle will be explained.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: We shall leave our eternal footprints on the stairway to the heavens!

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Hehe... Piece of cake.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Let's look for a larger world.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Taste my Hellbore Cannon!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: An environment with gravity is pretty interesting.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: This is the power of a space-walker!

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Ahaha, I guess I couldn't handle it after all...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Finally made up your mind, Professor?
I was wondering if I should make the first move, but fortunately I waited until now. I even have a speech ready and everything.
"We flew in from the distance, racing toward the furthest reaches of the sea of stars. This journey has given us hope and courage, and I'll do my best to reciprocate your feelings—"
Come to think of it, that works way better as a reply... Glad it all worked out.
Now then, allow me to take you on a tour of our sprawling universe! With us as trailblazers, the light of civilization will shine far and wide!

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year, Professor! Every country has its own practices for celebrating the new year. What's it like where you come from? You want to know about me? Well, I haven't spent much time planetside. It's all training and sims and more training... But judging by the pictures and videos everyone sends me, the new year seems reeeally lively. Want to try celebrating it that way in the Oasis?

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Chocolate is one of my favorite foods for taikonaut simulator training— It's both an emergency ration and a snack, and it tastes good, too. Although you can get sick of it after eating too much, today is a special occasion like Valentine's Day...  Want to try my favorite TMA Monolith space chocolate? Each bar is shaped in a 1:4:9 ratio and it's got a rich texture to it; I'm sure you won't be disappointed.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Are you stargazing, Professor? The sky sure is clear tonight. I've heard the story about the heavenly magpie bridge during Tanabata and how it's related to the Milky Way in the night sky. The truth is, every star in the Milky Way has a unique story of its own. For example, it could be one about an alien selling sandwiches on exotic planets, or dolphins that save human beings... If you put them all together, I bet you could write a hitchhiker's guide that was thicker than I am tall. Do you have any stories like that you'd like to tell me, Professor? Or... Would you like to listen to my stories instead?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Halloween? Hm... So I need to get a horror-themed costume, then? There are tons of space and sci-fi movies with horror or disaster themes out there... For instance, we could make a chestburster mask! Huh? It's too far ahead of its time? Well, I'm a fan of the body horror theme. How about— Hey, where did everyone go?

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Merry Christmas, Professor! I spent a lot of time preparing this gift for you. It's a full set of space-themed postcards from the 1980s. Back then, space was still— Ah, never mind, I'm really happy today. In the past, the only person I had to exchange gifts with was this little troublemaker here, and all it found was some pebbles and such... But it's different now. Alright, time to prepare some unique gifts for everyone.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text:
A birthday... That's like the awakening day for a Doll, right? I get it now.
I don't have an opinion about birthdays. After all, I threw myself wholeheartedly into my work after I was awakened. That's what Dolls were made for, after all. However, I doubt humans were born with a set purpose. That makes me wonder, what exactly did you go through during each step of the journey that led you to this point?  Maybe you could tell me all about it when you have the time. Until then, please accept this gift from me. Once again, happy birthday, Professor.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: 6:30AM, wake up. 7:00AM, have breakfast while adhering strictly to the workflow. 7:30AM, Zero-G environment endurance training... A taikonaut's life needs to be strictly regimented! After all, this is closely linked to the safety of the crew and the vessel as a whole. Still, I don't do these sorts of things every day; being wound up all the time is actually really bad for work. Do you feel that way, too, Professor? In the past, my instructor taught me to "know when to give and take". And now, I'll pass that lesson on to you as well.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
Phew... I can't stay inside my exo any longer. It's so hot and stuffy today, is there something wrong with the air circulation system... hm? Professor? Ahhhh, I bet you've hardly ever seen me like this, judging by how interested you look.
Hehe, there's a big contrast between this exo and how I really look, right? After all, Dolls resemble humans the most. Humans are insignificant little beings, yet they have the ability to build huge constructs to protect themselves and explore the unknown— whether they're big spaceships, exoskeletons, or anything else. Creation and exploration are part of the basic nature of space exploration, and as a space explorer, I naturally won't let anyone be disappointed. So place your trust in me, okay, Professor?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Although I'm always talking about space exploration... The truth is, I never managed to actually go to space before I came to Magrasea.
That's an accepted part of the real world, isn't it? Nobody's been able to travel into space any more. But there are always people who harbor that hope in their hearts. Even if it's covered up by dark clouds, even if most people think it's a fantasy... That little point of light will always be there.
And that's the reason why I was born. All my training, all my sim practice... It's because someday, I WILL go to space for real. That's the fire that burns forever in my taikonaut's heart.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Did I manage to fulfil my dreams by coming to Magrasea? Maybe, or maybe not... Hmmm, the truth is, I didn't really give the subject much thought. Looking back on it now, it really was a strange experience for me.
As I travelled through this gigantic "simulated universe", I was constantly surrounded by adventures and miracles I'd never imagined before. Having spent my entire life training and practicing, the first time I managed to actually float through such a marvelous world... I guess it'll be a long time before I ever get to see such things in reality. While I've made a lot of friends during my adventures, I always end up talking to "Liuxing" whenever I'm bored.
The truth is, "Liuxing" doesn't actually respond when I talk to it, but it does wonders for relieving my stress. Why don't you pour your heart out to it, too? It might be a troublemaker, but it'll never say you talk too much.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
It's been a while since I came to the Oasis, hm... I love it here. There's so much stuff I can do and lots of people to talk to, and I even got to meet a bunch of friends from my homeland! Still, when it comes to my "home"... I see it differently.
Look, this is the safety tether for my spacesuit. It joins me to the space station. Even the most prodigal of children think of their home from time to time, and this is the kite's string that keeps us from getting lost in space. As long as we can touch down, we can be ready to move out again at any time to explore more of the unknown—and besides, everyone back home is waiting to hear the good news from us.
Our curiosity and courage will take us far, but it's our feelings and our trust that bind us to home. To everyone, that's what the Oasis is during our days on the cloud. As long as you're in the Oasis, it can be a place for us to rest our heads and hang up our hats. Am I right, or am I right? Ahahaha, don't be shy~

voices.label: Agreement
voices.text: Ohhh!

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Whoa...

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehehe...

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: What are you doing?!

voices.label: Live2D2
voices.text: This equipment is quite rare, isn't it? Professor, feel free to come closer for a better look.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Professor~ I found something interesting in your room last night. Take a look at this—where did all this money come from? Do you think you can do whatever you want just because you're loaded? I'll give you a chance to come clean…

voices.label: Good afternoon
voices.text: Professor, are you still dealing with all that tedious paperwork? It's already past three o'clock, time for afternoon tea! Look, we have shrimp dumplings, mango pomelo sago, and buttered pineapple buns... Would you like some? Here, open wide—

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Professor? What are you doing in the car so late? A private space like this could easily become a crime scene… If I sense any naughty intentions from you, I might have to use these handcuffs~

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Freeze! You have the right to remain silent. Anything you say can and will be used against you in a court of law. How's that, Professor? Not bad for an undercover agent, wouldn't you say?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: The collar of my qipao... it's a bit tight. Professor, could you help loosen the ribbon for me? This traditional dress is the epitome of elegance, capable of disarming even the most guarded individuals. Of course, that also makes it a prime target for criminals. In that fleeting moment when their defenses crumble, one can swiftly immobilize them... Oh! I'm so sorry, Professor! My professional instincts accidentally kicked in...

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Time for a pat-down, Professor. Why so nervous? You wouldn't happen to be hiding anything dangerous in any... unusual places, would you?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Careful there, Professor! You don't want any accidental discharges, do you?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Bang! Haha! Did I scare you?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Is this… part of the task?

voices.label: Acquisition
voices.text: Undercover agent Xinghuan, reporting for duty! Pretty charming outfit, right? Remember, the most beautiful rose has the sharpest thorns. You'd better watch out, Professor.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Operation Project Neural Cloud is a go. Agent Xinghuan, joins the team!

voices.label: Start Combat
voices.text: YES SIR!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: If you are in this game, you'll have to pay back sooner or later!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Remember to give credit where it's due!

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Damn…

career:
The UE-921 space exploration Doll was custom-tailored by Svarog HI's Asia division for the "Jiutian Plan" space exploration project. Unit UE-921T, also known as "Xinghuan", was the prototype of the product line, and she was assigned to a local aerospace research base. Her duties there included testing human adaptability to high-energy Collapse radiation and zero-G environments, the feasibility of clearing space debris in low-Earth orbits, conducting control tests on space-use exoskeletons and miniaturized piloting capsules, and so on. Thanks to her balanced and overall exemplary capabilities, Xinghuan fulfilled all her tasks almost perfectly, distinguishing herself from several other test-type units and taking part in the training sessions for subsequent improved models.

The exact reason for Xinghuan's entry into Project Neural Cloud is unknown. Supposedly, it was part of the collaboration protocol that Svarog HI established with 42Lab, but it is also rumored that it was because of unexpected events during the project.
infoStories:
To some extent, the advent of space exploration Dolls is a clash between idealists and reality.

Due to the devastating worldwide Collapse Particle cloud pollution, the aerospace industry became stagnant and even began to regress. With no foreseeable timetable for the abatement of the Collapse Particle clouds and with no known technologies for overcoming their influence on the market, many countries' space agencies announced their closure, one after another, and humanity's prospects for exploring space grew slim. However, the "Jiutian Plan" space exploration project that was first proposed in the 2050s proved that humanity had not given up on its ambitions to venture into the cosmos.

As warfare and deteriorating environmental conditions whittled away at the talent pool for spacefarers, it forced the "Jiutian Plan" to find candidates that could partially replace human astronauts. Making already-rare human astronauts work in extremely dangerous environments was not wise. In turn, the participants turned their attention toward Doll technology, which was rapidly flourishing at the time.

To maximize their chances of meeting the project's complex requirements, the "Jiutian Plan" submitted multiple orders to Svarog HI. However, most of the theorized solutions ran into problems of excessive cost or technical stability. In the end, the only model that met with their approval was the UE-921 model. In keeping with the "Jiutian Plan's" requirements, the prototype was designated as a "test unit", or the UE-921T. After that, several other test-type units with minor design variations were rolled out and put into trials along with it. In the end, the best-performing unit turned out to be the UE-921T prototype, and as such, she earned a name for herself—"Xinghuan".

In stark contrast with the difficult development process for her model, Xinghuan's name contained her designers' inspiration and hope for exploring the cosmos. Xinghuan herself was an excellent fit for the vision of the "Jiutian Plan" for a taikonaut Doll. Her abilities were both balanced and reliable, she had no obvious shortcomings, and she demonstrated remarkable improvement after follow-up training. More importantly, she had tremendous room for improvement. She could handle a wide variety of tasks including space exploration, orbital engineering, and even military functions with the right modules.

Her excellent performance led to the project team's great expectations for her, and a tremendous amount of resources were poured into her during the development and testing phase. Given the need for her to engage in sustained, highly demanding activity in zero-G environments, Xinghuan's bodily and endoskeletal structures are unlike any other Doll's—in other words, Xinghuan's physical performance in environments with gravity was only just enough for basic functionality. To address this discrepancy between her bodily characteristics and her work environment, the researchers and her coaches devised a complex and intricate piece of equipment for her; a powered exoskeleton equipped with multipurpose limbs and vector-thrust nozzles for movement in zero-G environments, as well as a large-bore thermal energy discharge weapon.

Xinghuan was beside herself with joy when she received this piece of gear. The workers thought she might need more time for practice and acclimation to it, but she managed to grasp its controls in just a third of the expected time. Given her eagerness to pilot the exoskeleton, learning to use it was not so much completing a task as it was indulging her interests.

Despite all the expectations placed on her, Xinghuan never got to see or travel into space, due to reasons which we are all abundantly aware of. Most of her time was spent in the depths of the research base, inside a simulated zero-G facility. Many of the humans and Dolls who took part in experiments with Xinghuan ended up exhibiting various psychological issues or neural cloud confusion, due to the isolated environment. However, Xinghuan remained the sole exception; she maintained her cheerful and outgoing personality throughout the entire experimental regime and many of her colleagues commented that she was easygoing and energetic. At the same time, she displayed her reliable and trustworthy side as she worked. She was capable of effectively handling most emergencies and assisting her fellows.

Very few of the research team's anonymous internal reviews concerning her were negative. Perhaps they did not overflow with saccharine-sweet praise for her, but in general, the comments on her personality and skills were positive, aside from remarks such as "overly loud speaking voice", "too energetic", and "eats twice as much as the average person".

In addition, Xinghuan showed a marked preference for space-related sci-fi entertainment, probably due to the contents of her database. She could always be counted on to eagerly discuss such things both new and old, freely demonstrating her love for such fictional explorations of the depths of space. As a natural romantic, Xinghuan was an inheritor of humanity's endless dreams of space.

In her friends' eyes, Xinghuan was like her namesake; ever-radiant and dazzling. However, that did not mean she never felt down. Rather, she used her cheerful personality and forthright nature to find an appropriate channel for them. She considered every mission an interesting challenge, and named her support robot "Liuxing". In the company of her little friend, she managed to turn even the most boring schedule into an entertaining experience.

During her lengthy study and training period, she slowly became one of the base's veterans, having made friends with just about everyone there. After completing a series of assignments, Xinghuan had not even gone on vacation before she learned that she had been chosen to take part in Project Neural Cloud with a fellow prototype Doll "Yuwang". At first, she thought she would be having her vacation in the Neural Cloud sector, but after the Wipe-off Incident, she arrived in the space sector "Jiutian".

In Jiutian, Xinghuan got to experience something similar to what she had always been looking forward to; being able to someday "go to space". While she knew that this was little more than a complex simulation and part of the "Jiutian Plan" that had birthed her, she quickly devoted herself wholeheartedly to it and embarked on her own new journey within the secto—a grand odyssey with no end in sight.

After the great upheaval in the Jiutian sector, Xinghuan awakened again in the Oasis.

When she first began living in the Oasis, Xinghuan ran into a series of problems: this "comfortable" environment was utterly unfamiliar to her, while her reawakening had led to brief neural cloud confusion and amnesia, as well as a bunch of accidents caused by exceptionally poor adaptation to her new environment—

"Wait, can I really not fly my exo around here?"
—Audio clip taken after an accident involving her exoskeleton in the Oasis' central plaza, resulting in temporary detention by Evelyn.

However, Xinghuan adjusted to her environment with startling speed and quickly established new friendships with the people around her, including (but not limited to) Croque and the Professor. The former was deeply interested in Xinghuan's abilities as well as her skills at piloting her powered exoskeleton. As for the latter, Xinghuan was unusually enthusiastic about them. Perhaps it was because of a certain resonance between idealists, or perhaps it was due to an explorer's keen senses, but she ended up equally fond of and curious about the Professor.

"Someone as passionate and frighteningly adaptable as her isn't something you see often."
—A certain comment on the Oasis' anonymous message board.
oathDesc: Set out on a journey with her.
